Apple TV has had an outstanding year, with its latest series《Small Prophets》being hailed as the streaming platform's most impressive premiere of 2026. Below are summaries of reviews from major media outlets.

《Small Prophets》Praised by Critics as an Apple TV 'Masterpiece'

Apple TV's comedy lineup this year has been remarkably strong, featuring new seasons of《Shrinking》,《Ted Lasso》, and《Trying》, along with the original hit series《Widow's Bay》—the latter having shone brightly at the recent Emmy Awards ceremony.

Now, its latest comedy《Small Prophets》appears poised to continue this strong momentum.

《Small Prophets》will premiere tonight at 9 PM Eastern Time / 6 PM Pacific Time, and has immediately received unanimous critical acclaim.

We already knew《Small Prophets》was well-loved, given that it is one of the few acquired series on Apple TV. The show had previously aired in the UK, and now Apple is bringing it to global audiences.

A new round of reviews further confirms that《Small Prophets》stands apart from the rest. The series has achieved a 100% fresh rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Below is the review from《The Hollywood Reporter》:

The review from《The Verge》also offers high praise:

Other media reviews have also lavished praise on the show, calling it a 'gentle, exquisitely crafted, and unhurried masterpiece,' with one critic exclaiming: 'The interweaving of multiple storylines is nothing short of genius.'

In short, if you find yourself wanting more after watching the season finale of《Ted Lasso》Season 4 tonight, Apple TV can absolutely satisfy your needs with another outstanding comedy.

Are you planning to watch《Small Prophets》? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.

Apple TV's monthly subscription is USD 14.99, or you can enjoy discounted pricing through an Apple One bundle subscription.
